description: Unopened Feetech STS3250 servo package, with the servo still inside

dimensions_mm.provenance: Owner measurements; approximate. These override the supplied generic package-size estimate.

mass_provenance: Owner-supplied estimate for the complete unopened package, including the servo; not a manufacturer specification

contact_estimates.provenance: Owner-supplied estimates, not measured coefficients or manufacturer specifications
contact_estimates.interpretation: Rubber-gripper friction describes that material pair, not the table contact. These are physical estimates, not an MJCF friction vector; MuJoCo requires separate choices for sliding, torsional, and rolling friction and contact solver parameters.

mass_distribution.note: The servo and packaging mass distribution is unmeasured; a centered uniform rigid box would be an explicit initial approximation.
